dialogue-tags.desc: Verbs that attribute speech — alternatives to "said", grouped by what they signal: volume, emotion, tone, pacing, confidence, questioning, persuasion, deception, affection, authority, hesitation, and more.

action-verbs.desc: Physical beats and body language for action lines between dialogue — gaze, facial expressions, gestures, posture, movement, touch, nervous habits, startle reactions, and object interaction.

delivery-modifiers.desc: Adverbs describing HOW a line is spoken ("…he said, softly"), grouped by mood — warm, cold, sharp, sarcastic, playful, nervous, reluctant, firm, calm, impatient, sad, or excited.

internal-sensations.desc: What emotions physically feel like from the inside — racing hearts, dropped stomachs, caught breath, prickling skin — grouped by body part and by feeling (longing, dread, grief, relief).

transitions.desc: Scene and time connectors for stitching a round-robin story together — time skips, scene shifts, gradual vs sudden change, flashbacks, POV pivots, and scene endings.
